scope_note: This records Georgas and Mylonas's disciplinary placement in the 2006 volume; branch placement does not make the two identities aliases or settle every historiographic account.
statement: Georgas and Mylonas describe indigenous psychology as becoming a branch of cross-cultural psychology through its emphasis on in-depth cultural context.
statement_zh: Georgas 與 Mylonas 將 indigenous psychology 描述為因強調深入文化脈絡而成為 cross-cultural psychology 的一個分支。
